Today, David went to the coffee shop. Between what times could they have gone?

David woke up at 8am.
Elizabeth saw David waiting at the airport from 10am to 1pm.
David saw David playing tennis at the tennis court from 1pm to 2pm.
Jessica saw David working out at the gym from 2pm to 3pm.
Susan saw David waiting at the train station from 3pm to 4pm.
Sean saw David sitting on a rooftop from 4pm to 6pm.
The coffee shop was closed after 6pm.
Between what times could David have gone to the coffee shop?

Options:
(A) 3pm to 4pm
(B) 10am to 1pm
(C) 8am to 10am
(D) 1pm to 2pm

Think step by step about the question. Keep reasoning concise (under 300 words). Then give your final answer on the last line in exactly this format: Answer: (X)

- (A) 3pm to 4pm: This is not possible because David was at the train station during this time.
- (B) 10am to 1pm: This is possible because David was at the airport during this time, and he could have gone to the coffee shop before or after his airport activities.
- (C) 8am to 10am: This is not possible because David woke up at 8am and went to the airport by 10am.
- (D) 1pm to 2pm: This is not possible because David was playing tennis during this time.

The only time when David could have gone to the coffee shop is between 10am and 1pm.

Answer: (B)
